3D coordinate axes

Source: R/geom-axes-3d.R
geom_axes_3d.Rd

geom_axes_3d() draws a line along each of the x, y, and z axes through an origin, each spanning the panel's full range along its axis, with an arrowhead and a label at its high end. Unlike the axes drawn on the edges of the panel by coord_3d(), these are part of the 3D scene, so they are depth-sorted with the plot's other geometry. This suits diagrams, such as plots of vectors, where the axes should pass through the origin.

Usage

geom_axes_3d(
  x = 0,
  y = 0,
  z = 0,
  labels = c("x", "y", "z"),
  arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed"),
  arrow.fill = NULL,
  ...,
  scale_depth = TRUE,
  on_top = FALSE
)

Arguments

x, y, z

Coordinates of the origin the axes pass through, each a single number. Default 0.

labels

Labels for the x, y, and z axes, drawn just beyond each axis's high end: a length-3 vector, with NA or "" to leave an axis unlabelled, or NULL for no labels.

arrow

Arrowhead specification created by grid::arrow(), or NULL for none. The default is a closed 6pt arrowhead.

arrow.fill

Fill colour for closed arrowheads. NULL (the default) uses each axis's colour.

...

Aesthetics applied as fixed values: colour, alpha, and, for the lines, linewidth and linetype, and for the labels, size, family, and fontface. Each can have length 1, or length 3 to style the x, y, and z axes separately.

scale_depth

Controls depth-based scaling, drawing closer elements larger or thicker and farther ones smaller or thinner. TRUE (the default) applies full scaling and FALSE disables it; a number sets the strength directly, where 1 matches TRUE, 0 matches FALSE, values below 1 subdue the effect and values above 1 exaggerate it. This affects the layer only; use coord_3d(scale_depth = ) for panel and axis components.

on_top

If TRUE, the layer is drawn on top of the rest of the scene instead of being depth-sorted with it, so other geometry never hides or cuts it, e.g. to keep labels legible. The layers drawn on top are depth-sorted among themselves. Default FALSE.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Details

Axes are built from the panel's limits when the plot is drawn, so they don't expand the plot's axis ranges. Positions are in the plot's (transformed) scale space.

Examples

# Axes through the origin, depth-sorted with a surface
ggplot() +
  geom_function_3d(fun = function(x, y) (x^2 - y^2) / 2,
                   xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), n = 20) +
  geom_axes_3d(linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_3d(panels = "none") +
  theme_void()


# Styled per axis, with an offset origin
ggplot(sphere_points, aes(x, y, z)) +
  geom_hull_3d(fill = "grey80", colour = "grey60", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_axes_3d(x = -1, y = -1, z = -1,
               colour = c("tomato", "seagreen", "steelblue"),
               labels = c("east", "north", "up")) +
  coord_3d()
